about: A maxParallel on a sequential for (chapter 4 § 4.2.3). Invalid: the for sections declares "parallel": false with "maxParallel": 4. Valid: "parallel": false with "maxParallel": null.
sentences: Loop 'sections' declares maxParallel 4 with parallel false; a sequential loop runs one item at a time: write "maxParallel": null.
